title: Smelting Iron in Africa (A DEMONSTRATION)
summary: A 105-minute film of a West African smith family in Burkina Faso smelting iron from ore, from making charcoal and building the kiln to forging tools. It is a cultural recreation filmed for the camera, not current practice.
why: Recommended as an amazing documentary of traditional ironmaking, often used as a baseline for the labor required.

quote.text: One of my favorite videos is a documentary of a village in Africa that goes through the process of producing iron tools from scratch
